column1: # Tolbi, after Ash Jenna: Isaac asks Mia for the Tideglass Blade.

column3: Mia. Jenna said the light\nmade you both. Is she\nright?{end_wait}
Careful, Isaac. You speak\nto me as if you still\nknew your place.{end_wait}
The blade. It is not\nyours, is it? Give it\nto me.{end_wait}
Fool. The voice you hate\nwas never mine. It came\nwith the sword.{end_wait}
It speaks when I am angry.\nWhen I am afraid. I\ncannot make it stop.{end_wait}

Then choose, Isaac. Take
the blade and leave me
weak, or trust me?{page_break}Will you take the
Tideglass Blade?{end_now}
Then take it. I will be\nweaker... and quieter.\nPerhaps that is mercy.{end_wait}
You keep me as I am.\nPity or wisdom, I will\nnot thank you for it.{end_wait}
